data.name: Radisson Hotel Panama Canal
data.address: C. Van Hook, Panamá, Provincia de Panamá, Panama
data.description:
Overlooking the Panama Canal, this relaxed hotel is 6 km from Marcos A. Gelabert International Airport and 5 km from Albrook Mall.
The laid-back rooms, some with canal views, provide free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as minibars, microwaves and coffeemakers; most have balconies. Suites add living areas, conference tables and/or in-room whirlpool tubs. Kids age 11 and under stay at no cost with an adult.
Hot breakfast, a mall shuttle and parking are complimentary. There's also a warm restaurant, an American-style eatery and a cafe. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, a kids' pool and a hot tub, plus a gym and a playground.
